openwrt_git.titel: ath79: add support for Sophos AP100/AP55 family
spezifikation_alle: Qualcomm QCA9558 SoC @ 720 MHz (MIPS 74Kc Big-endian processor)
Green and Red status LEDs sharing a single external light-pipe
Alternate power supply via 5.5x2.1mm DC jack @ 12 VDC
ap100_ap55: USB 2.0 Type A port, power controlled via GPIO 11

fussnoten.1: Button is present but does not alter state of any GPIO on SoC
fussnoten.2: Buzzer and driver circuitry is present on PCB but is not connected to any GPIO. Shorting an unpopulated resistor next to the driver circuitry should connect the buzzer to GPIO 4, but this is unconfirmed.
fussnoten.3: This external RJ45 serial port is disabled in the OEM firmware, but works in OpenWRT without additional configuration, at least on my three test units.
fussnoten.4: On AP100/AP55 models the UART header is accessible after removing the device's top cover. On AP100C/AP55C models, the PCB must be removed for access; three screws secure it to the case. Pin 1 is marked on the silkscreen. Pins from 1-4 are 3.3V, GND, TX, RX
